//events: Three PLACEHOLDERS so the pages can be seen working — edit them or delete them. The menu counts these, the homepage picks its featured event and its cards out of them, and /events splits them into upcoming and past from the date alone. Two are dated ahead and one behind, so both groups appear.

events.title: An Evening With…
events.summary: A guest speaker, a short reminder, and food afterwards. Open to everyone.
events.body:
We are hosting an evening for the older boys and anyone else who wants to come along.

The talk runs for about forty minutes with questions afterwards, and there is food once it finishes. Bring a friend — there is no need to book, but it helps us to know numbers if you let us know you are coming.

events.title: Half-Term Football
events.summary: Five-a-side over half term. All ages, all abilities, nothing to pay.
events.body:
Teams are picked on the day, so turn up on your own or bring the whole group.

Bring trainers and a water bottle. If it is raining we move indoors — check the WhatsApp group on the morning.

events.title: Summer Camp 2026
events.summary: Three days away: walking, cooking badly, and a lot of talking.
events.body:
Our third summer camp, and the biggest one yet.

This one has been and gone — it is here so you can see what the past section looks like. Delete it once there is a real one to put in its place.
